Generate a Stics workspace from IDEStics data, for evaluation.

Source: R/gen_workspace_from_idestics.R
gen_workspace_from_idestics.Rd

Retrieves the rotations and USMs data from the IDEStics API, completes them with the model and plant files of the Stics repository, and generates the corresponding text workspace. The rotations are written to metadata.csv in output_dir.

The IDEStics credentials are read from the IDESTICS_USERNAME and IDESTICS_PASSWORD environment variables if they are set (e.g. in the user-level ~/.Renviron). Otherwise, they are prompted for in an interactive session, the password being masked.

Usage

gen_workspace_from_idestics(
  idestics_url,
  stics_path,
  output_dir,
  stics_version,
  usms,
  parallel = FALSE,
  cores = NA,
  force_code_shape = TRUE,
  verbose = 1L,
  batch_size = 300L,
  max_active = 10L,
  usms_files = lifecycle::deprecated()
)

Arguments

idestics_url

URL of the IDEStics server

stics_path

path to Stics repository

output_dir

path to the Stics workspace to generate

stics_version

Stics version of the USMs to retrieve, as listed by the IDEStics API (e.g. "11.0.0")

usms

character vector of USM names to generate. Use read_usms_files to read them from USM list files.

parallel

Boolean. Is the computation to be done in parallel ?

cores

Number of cores to use for parallel computation

force_code_shape

Boolean. Should the code_shape parameter be forced to 2 for intercrop plant files (see set_intercrop_code_shape) ? Default TRUE.

verbose

Integer. Logging verbosity level: 0 = warnings and errors only, 1 = info, 2 = debug

batch_size

Number of USMs requested to the IDEStics API per request. Inf requests all the USMs at once.

max_active

Maximum number of requests to the IDEStics API performed in parallel.

usms_files

Deprecated. Use usms = read_usms_files(usms_files) instead.

Value

NULL (invisibly)
